The '''Swampway 200''' was a popular biannual [[Skimmer/Legends|skimmer]] race hosted by [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ozz (Ugnaught)/Legends|Ozz]], which followed a course called the [[Ugnorgrad Swampway]] through [[Grukk's Jungle]] and [[Phizbin Marsh]]. The treacherous course included potentially deadly jumps over gaps in the [[Ugnaught Surface/Legends|Ugnaught Surface]] exoskeleton, where multiple racers had perished.<ref name="ActionTidings2" /> The race brought many tourists to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]<ref name="ActionTidings5">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20041028bespin5|series=Bespin: Action Tidings|text=Part 5: An Exclusive!}}</ref> to watch the racers in their custom skimmers, but some [[Ufflor officer|ufflors]] feared it could attract unwanted criminal attention from the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="ActionTidings2" />
